description: Public Reference Data for Megawatt-Scale Hydrogen Electrolysis - NLR Historical Solar PV is a data set deposited in DOE National Library of the Rockies (NLR) Repository by its authors Riley Abel, Marty Schwarz (National Laboratory of the Rockies). The U.S. Department of Energy and National Laboratory of the Rockies (NLR) demonstrate hydrogen electrolysis from variable sources, hydrogen compression and storage, and hydrogen fuel cell power production using megawatt-scale equipment at NLR’s Flatirons Campus as part of the Advanced Research on Integrated Energy Systems (ARIES) research platform. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 6 files.. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
